summary: Bangalore, India, software engineer, Perl and Java programmer, self-taught, strong advocate for meritocracy in hiring, critical of job-hopping culture, believes in education reform, interested in technology and programming languages, passionate about productivity and efficiency, values discipline and hard work, critical of corporate politics, supports open-source software, concerned about social issues in India, family-oriented, skeptical of Western perceptions of India, emphasizes the importance of financial literacy and saving, believes in the value of practical experience over formal education.
